title: DefiLlama DEX dashboard
observation: Dashboard reports DEX turnover and protocol rankings; numerical capture is in money_flow_snapshot.json.
design_implication: Rank discovery attention; this is not executable liquidity.

title: DefiLlama derivatives dashboard
observation: Reported and normalized volume are separate columns; open interest is a stock.
design_implication: Keep metric definitions and revisions; do not infer flashloan capacity.

title: DefiLlama stablecoins dashboard
observation: Stablecoin market capitalization is a stock of value.
design_implication: Use as a settlement-asset discovery signal, not trading flow.

title: DefiLlama lending dashboard
observation: TVL, supplied assets and active loans are distinct columns.
design_implication: Read each lender reserve separately for a funding decision.

title: DefiLlama metric definitions
observation: DEX turnover aggregates trades; active loans are excluded from default TVL to limit looping inflation.
design_implication: Prevent routed-volume and recycled-capital double counting.

title: Jito account-lock auctions and bundle caveats
observation: Intersecting write/write or read/write account locks share auctions; read/read may separate. Rebroadcast from skipped blocks can lose bundle-level atomicity.
design_implication: Use complete resource footprints and lender-scoped debt closure; bundle acceptance is not settlement.

title: Solana transactions
observation: Instructions in a transaction succeed atomically; failed transactions can still incur fees.
design_implication: Forecast failure costs and version transaction limits; no hardcoded future capacity promise.

title: Ethereum transactions
observation: An account transaction nonce is sequential; gas payment is required.
design_implication: Separate sender nonce lanes from parallel research workers and economic conflicts.

title: Aave V3 flash loans
observation: Multi-reserve flashLoan and single-reserve flashLoanSimple have different fee/debt options; the premium is governance-configurable.
design_implication: Read actual reserve flags, balance, premium and callback terms. Debt conversion requires separate collateral or delegation.

title: Morpho Blue flashLoan
observation: Blue documents access to the token balance of the contract, zero flash fee and a non-ERC-3156 interface.
design_implication: Deduplicate a shared contract balance across markets; confirm deployment and token semantics.

title: Balancer V3 flash loans
observation: The current page describes V3 unlock, borrowing and settle within the transaction.
design_implication: Do not apply old V2 ABI or fee assumptions to V3.

title: Yellowstone gRPC
observation: Open-source Solana streaming service; repository displays AGPL-3.0.
design_implication: Software availability is separate from hosting, validator access, data rights and operational costs.

title: Helius LaserStream
observation: Mainnet access requires a Business or Professional plan; devnet availability is broader.
design_implication: Paid optional feed, not an unlimited free mainnet source. Validate replay and delivery semantics before adoption.

title: Binance Spot market streams
observation: The market-data interface includes depth snapshots and update identifiers.
design_implication: A venue-specific synchronization procedure and depth coverage proof are required; no universal delta parser.

title: Coinbase Exchange level2
observation: Level2 begins with a snapshot; an update size replaces the level size and zero removes the level.
design_implication: Do not treat absolute sizes as additive deltas. Reconnect and full-channel sequencing differ.

title: Hyperliquid WebSocket subscriptions
observation: l2Book parameters include precision and a fast mode; documented fast/slow depths are 5/20 levels.
design_implication: Mark depth and precision coverage. A bounded book cannot certify fills beyond its visible depth.

title: Geth real-time events
observation: Subscriptions are connection-bound; reorgs can emit old logs with removed=true and repeat transactions.
design_implication: Persist a recoverable cursor, backfill and reverse prior state before computing new evidence.

title: Sui object model
observation: Object references bind ID, version and digest; transaction changes create new versions.
design_implication: Track owned/shared object dependencies and gas objects as resources, not just token pairs.

title: DefiLlama API services
observation: Free and Pro APIs have separate bases and authentication; free endpoints exist.
design_implication: Choose documented free endpoints with quotas; do not accidentally route a job into paid paths.

title: DEX Screener API reference
observation: Reference exposes discovery and pair endpoints with endpoint-specific rate limits.
design_implication: Use for discovery and metadata, not amount-exact pool-state reconstruction.

title: CoinGecko / GeckoTerminal documentation
observation: The old GeckoTerminal guide redirects here; a free Demo API has limited endpoints and rate limits.
design_implication: Verify the chosen API family, key requirement and plan; do not assume all onchain routes are free.

title: The Graph query service
observation: The linked documentation includes billing for queries.
design_implication: Indexing lag, schema revision and provider budget are part of the contract; unlimited free use is unverified.

title: Dune API
observation: The API uses keys; metadata endpoints are listed as free.
design_implication: Query execution and result access need separate credit/plan checks; use for slow historical research.

title: Project 0 / former marginfi documentation entrypoint
observation: The current homepage describes Project 0 on mrgnLendv2 with cross-venue collateral.
design_implication: Treat naming/SDK drift as a qualification trigger, not automatic compatibility with a legacy lending adapter.

title: Uniswap V3 flash guide
observation: The V3 pool flash callback owes borrowed amounts plus fees within the transaction.
design_implication: Bind lender pool locks and callback restrictions when composing swap legs.

title: Kamino lending source repository
observation: The official public repository is available for code and revision qualification.
design_implication: This review did not prove the deployed revision, flash fee, current reserve cash or full callback behavior.
